اخترطا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَطَا (iḵtaraṭā) /ix.ta.ra.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اُخْتُرِطَا (uḵturiṭā) /ux.tu.ri.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اِخْتَرِطَا (iḵtariṭā) /ix.ta.ri.tˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
